move: prompt types, Generate press spins rainbow border, Done state, result tiles stagger in
how: A dark prompt box (text field, three chips, a white 200px Generate pill, three hidden result tiles) rises in with expo.out over the first 9% of the 7s loop. From 0.3s TextPlugin types the prompt over 1.6s with ease none while a cursor glides to the button. Press at 2.3s (33%): the pill scales 0.94 then elastic.out(1,0.45); the 'Generate' label rolls up out (yPercent -110, expo.out) as a black 'Generating' label with a spinner rolls in, and an oversized conic-gradient border layer fades in and rotates 720deg linearly over 2.4s while the spinner turns 1080. At 4.8s (69%) the label rolls to a green 'Done' with a check, the border fades, the pill pops 1.06 and settles elastically, and three gradient tiles rise from y 30 / scale 0.9 with back.out(1.8) staggered 0.1s. At 6.5s the box exits upward and the cursor returns to its start corner.
adapt: Change the prompt string, chip labels, the three state labels and colours, and replace the tiles with real output images; the conic border stops set the loading palette. Keep the 2.4s linear border spin and the label roll timing.
port: mount(el, shot) builds glow, box (field, chips, gen pill with border/inner/three labels, out tiles) and cursor inside el, measuring GX/GY from the pill rect relative to el; register TextPlugin. animate returns the timeline with typing 0.043D to 0.27D, press 0.33D, loading 0.343D to 0.686D, done 0.686D, exit 0.93D. The from() on the box needs immediateRender:false.
caveats: cursor target measured from getBoundingClientRect at build time
